design: INDIVIDUAL 17: a compact ancient female council elder with rounded powerful torso and umber-grey spotted scales, deeply textured orbital ridges, white-and-charcoal scalp tendrils just below shoulders fastened with three dark stone clips. An ivory shawl fully draped across both shoulders, plum pleated long tunic and a belt of asymmetric bronze council seals. Holds a closed teal voting folio vertically against the abdomen, both hands resting on its top edge. Reserved patient stance.
